{{Quote|The gram mass only weighs 0.9999973 grams, and the milligram mass only weighs 0.99822 milligrams. The other standards are also out.|Corwin Shelvay|<ref name="Calibration">{{WEGCite|book=Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim|story=Calibration Check}}</ref>}}
A '''milligram''' was a unit of mass measurement.<ref name="Calibration" />

==Behind the scenes==
The milligram was first mentioned in the [[1993]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'' by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]],<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> including in the short companion narrative "[[Calibration Check]]."<ref name="Calibration" />
